title: feat(family): the wave 2 componentes centralization — every app keeps only anchors beside Sol/componentes
body: The architecture the owner ordered: every application of the family centralizes its whole component surface into Sol/componentes/<page>/ and every page folder keeps only its anchor file — the file carrying the folder's own name. The moves preserve git history (renames) and every import (relative, alias, the .js convention specifiers) was rewritten resolution-based: moved components reach the app root three levels up, anchors mount their components from the componentes subfolder, and the PascalCase anchors (Shell.tsx, Toast.tsx) stay home as the anchors they are. devthink centralized 73 components, the ten family apps centralized 67 more, and every app typechecks clean after the pass.
commitTitle: feat(family): the wave 2 componentes centralization lands — every app keeps only anchors beside Sol/componentes
commitMessage: the architecture law lands family wide: devthink centralizes 73 components into Sol/componentes (27 page contexts), argan 2, cadria 18, debonair 12, forge 6, foundry 7, getry 5, stealthhead 5, vault 6, cobaia 3 and saddle 22 — every page folder keeps only its anchor, every import rewritten resolution-based (relative, alias and js-convention specifiers), the PascalCase anchors restored home, all eleven apps typechecking clean.
